caveat: Commonwealth Financial Assistance Grant allocation administered by the VLGGC: grant income, not council spending. One printed total per council per year; no cross-council total and no invented component sum. FAG is a component of council grant revenue and overlaps VGC1 grant revenue/ABS grant lines, so every row is potential_double_count=true and is never added to VGC1/ABS spending or to any other grant source.
